methodology_note: v2 (corrected): data variable = abs(amplitude_adc - baseline_adc) [net signal above hardware pedestal ~6752 ADC]; MC variable = gain * (edep_l0 + edep_l1) * peak_frac where peak_frac=0.733 from digitizer scintillation model (tau_r=2.5ns, tau_d=42ns, dt=10ns). v1 error: used raw amplitude_adc (included 6752-ADC hardware pedestal) against MC signal above digitizer model pedestal (350 ADC) — apples-to-oranges comparison.

calibration.gain_note: data B2 net_adc median=1781 ADC / (MC edep_B2 median=26.44 MeV * peak_frac=0.733) = 91.9 ADC/MeV
gain_unc_sources: B2 stopping-fraction MC vs data mismatch (B2 data includes pile-up; n_data=579k vs n_MC_B2=321k)
Mixed pulse polarity in B2 (35% positive, 65% negative vs 100% negative in B4-B8)
KS-optimal gain = 60 ADC/MeV (KS=0.12) vs median-matched 92 ADC/MeV: shape disagreement 32%
No data-level selection threshold simulation applied to MC (threshold ~14.8 MeV at gain=92)
calibration.pedestal_note: digitizer model DC offset (NOT data hardware pedestal); data hardware pedestal ~6752 ADC (median baseline_adc), already removed by taking net_adc
